name: Mobile App (Android + iOS)
description: One web codebase (Vite) wrapped by Capacitor — the same app ships as a website preview, an Android APK/AAB (store-ready, signed via GitHub Secrets), and an iOS app, with Play/App Store metadata scaffolded.
workflow_extra:
android:
    # Debug APK built on the repo's own Actions minutes (ubuntu runner,
    # free incl. private repos). The artifact is attached to the run.
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/{branch}'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - run: npm ci || npm install
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
      - run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-debug-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
  android-release:
    # Store-ready SIGNED Android App Bundle (.aab) for Google Play.
    # Signs with an upload keystore from GitHub Secrets. If the secrets are
    # absent this job skips its build steps with a notice (it does NOT fail
    # CI). Uploading to Play is a manual step in Play Console.
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/{branch}'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
      ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
      ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - name: Check signing secrets
        id: gate
        run: |
          if [ -n "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ] && [ -n "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ] && [ -n "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ] && [ -n "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then
            echo "signed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "signed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice title=android-release skipped::Add ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64, ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS and ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD as repository secrets to build a signed release AAB. See STORE-CHECKLIST.md."
            echo "android-release skipped: signing secrets are not configured (see STORE-CHECKLIST.md)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - name: Derive version
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        run: |
          TAG="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then
            echo "VERSION_NAME=${TAG#v}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            echo "VERSION_NAME=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi
          echo "VERSION_CODE=${{ github.run_number }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: npm ci || npm install
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
      - run: npm run build
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
      - run: npx cap add android
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
      - name: Generate icons from assets/icon.png
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        run: node scripts/generate-icons.mjs --android
      - run: npx cap sync android
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
      - name: Apply release config (targetSdk 36, version, 16 KB, signing)
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/upload-keystore.jks"
          echo "ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PATH=$RUNNER_TEMP/upload-keystore.jks" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          node scripts/android-release-config.mjs android
      - run: cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        with:
          name: app-release-aab
          path: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
      - name: Remove keystore
        if: always() && steps.gate.outputs.signed == 'true'
        run: rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/upload-keystore.jks"
  ios:
    # iOS needs a macOS runner — free only on PUBLIC repos (private repos
    # bill macOS minutes at 10x), so this job skips private repos by
    # design. Debug simulator build, unsigned.
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/{branch}' && github.event.repository.private == false
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm ci || npm install
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
      - run: cd ios/App && pod install || pod install --repo-update
      - run: cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
